items.title: Bannu peace committee agrees to no protests as talks with police conclude
items.description: BANNU: Successful talks between the Police Peace Committee and police officials concluded on Sunday, with the former submitting an 11-point written assurance, which outlines a code of conduct for committee members. Under the assurance, submitted to the regional police officer (RPO) and district police officer (DPO), peace committee members will not participate in protests, strikes, sit-ins or political activities and will perform their duties within the framework of the law. According to the written assurance, no committee member will arrest any person without legal authority. Action against individuals wanted in terrorism or other serious cases will be taken through the relevant law enforcement agencies, particularly the Counter-Terrorism Department (CTD). Committee members will cooperate with the army, Frontier Corps (FC), CTD and other law enforcement agencies (LEAs) only on the directions of authorised officials. The assurance also stated that members will refrain from exceeding their authority and engaging in unlawful activities, while accepting legal action in case of any violation of the code. The talks were held at Bannu Police Lines and were attended by RPO Bannu Abdul Ghafoor Afridi, MNA Maulana Syed Naseem Ali Shah, MNA Sher Afzal Khan Marwat, MPA Malik Pakhtunyar Khan and other local elders. During the talks, estranged PTI leader Marwat expressed reservations over the transfers of Police Peace Committee members, saying that instead of transferring them, authorities should examine why the committee was formed in the first place and what circumstances compelled police personnel to take such a step. Earlier this week, Police Peace Committee President Hazratullah objected to the transfer of seven Khyber Pakhtunkhwa police constables to other districts. He called on the personnel to boycott their duties, resulting in disruptions to police services and the traffic system in several areas. The MNA affirmed that the 2.2 million people of Bannu and Lakki Marwat stood with the Police Peace Committee. He said sacrifices in the region had created hope among the people and that the situation was gradually improving. He urged authorities to avoid steps that could undermine the committee’s role, warning that if weakening the committee resulted in terrorists becoming active again, the responsibility would rest with the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa inspector general. He urged Chief Minister Sohail Afridi, KP IG Zulfiqar Hameed and the chief secretary to resolve issues concerning the Police Peace Committee through consultation at the local level and to take all stakeholders into confidence on matters relating to peace and security. Meanwhile, MNA Shah called for the formation of district-level empowered committees for future decisions concerning the police in Bannu and Lakki Marwat, saying that decisions should not be imposed without local consultation. MPA Pakhtunyar stated that he stood with the police and the Police Peace Committee, adding that if any attempt was made to create obstacles in their way or undermine their role, he would stand firmly with both the police and the committee. Meanwhile, in Lakki Marwat, the Police Peace Committee ended its four-day protest following talks with the Bannu RPO in the presence of Marwat. During the negotiations, assurances were given for the recovery of an abducted police official, who was subsequently recovered. The talks also covered the cancellation of transfers of certain police personnel and local elders, provision of modern equipment to the police and improvement of security arrangements. It has also been decided to seek FC’s services for the security of sensitive locations in Bannu and Lakki Marwat. Bannu district has been the scene of repeated security incidents in recent months, with both civilians and local security forces coming under attack amid a broader surge in militant violence. On August 10, a police constable was martyred when unidentified armed men opened fire on him in the district’s Sorani area. The same day, the district police, CTD and security forces conducted a joint operation in the jurisdiction of the Miryan police station, leading to the killing of an unidentified terrorist and the arrest of 10 suspected individuals. Days later, the police and security forces claimed to have killed five terrorists and injured several others during a joint intelligence-based operation in parts of Domel tehsil. According to the Pakistan Institute for Conflict and Security Studies , an Islamabad-based think tank, violence linked to terrorist attacks and counter-terrorism operations intensified sharply in July, making it the deadliest month of 2026, with 112 security personnel among 205 people killed.

items.title: No students killed at Osun convention – NANS
items.description: By Shina Abubakar Osogbo The National Association of Nigerian Students, NANS, has described reports that an ex-student of Osun State Polytechnic was killed at its recently concluded convention in Osun State as untrue. A national daily (not Vanguard) reported that one Ademiju Ayeni, popularly called “Jago” was stabbed to death at the convention venue, the NUJ Secretariat in Osogbo. However, a statement issued by Zone D NANS Coordinator, Comrade Adeyemo Josiah disclosed that nobody was killed at the convention, saying the deceased’s death occurred hours after the conclusion of the body’s meeting. He explained, “The official proceedings were conducted within the controlled premises of the NUJ Council, Capital Road, Osogbo. Accreditation and access were handled by the Convention Planning Committee, while personnel of the Nigeria Police Force, DSS and other security formations were present throughout the exercise. “The convention proceedings were also extensively documented through video recordings and live broadcasts, including TikTok Live, while the exercise received media coverage, including from national television. These records provide additional documentation of what transpired within the official convention environment. “An earlier verbal disagreement involving the deceased and some persons was reportedly observed outside the convention gate. Information obtained during our fact-finding indicates that security personnel and stakeholders intervened and the disagreement was amicably resolved. No stabbing was reported during that encounter”. While stressing the need for accurate information dissemination, Josiah urged the media not to become a purveyor of misleading information used by aggrieved individuals to discredit a credible convention. “We equally caution aggrieved student leaders and political actors against attempting to weaponise this unfortunate death because of interests that were not realised during the just-concluded JCC election. “The election has ended. The death of a young man must not become an instrument for political retaliation, factional propaganda or another round of division within the Osun student constituency. “Our fact-finding has so far established one important point which must be placed clearly before the public and that is: No student was killed inside the NANS JCC Osun Convention, and the available information does not establish that the fatal incident occurred during the official convention proceedings. “Whatever eventually caused the death of Comrade Jago must be determined through a proper investigation based on witnesses, medical evidence, timelines and other credible evidence. “Whoever is established to be responsible must answer for his or her actions, but innocent individuals must equally not be condemned through rumours, assumptions or political interests”. The post No students killed at Osun convention – NANS appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Tarifs du passeport algérien pour la diaspora : ce qui change
items.description: Les membres de la communauté nationale à l'étranger ont longtemps été obligés de payer 60 € de droits de timbre pour la délivrance d’un passeport algérien (28 pages), alors que ces derniers sont fixés à 6.000 dinars pour les Algériens résidents. Il s'agissait d'une « injustice » faite aux membres de la communauté algérienne à l'étranger, avait déploré le député de la diaspora Farès Rahmani. Chose que la loi de finances 2026 est venue corriger. Timbre du passeport algérien : la diaspora paye moins depuis le début 2026 La loi de finances 2026, entrée en vigueur le 1er janvier dernier, a acté le changement, en alignant la contre-valeur en devises à payer pour l'obtention d'un passeport algérien « sur le cours du dinar face aux devises étrangères ». Il est à noter que l'ancienne contre-valeur était fixée selon un cours du dinar obsolète. La nouvelle loi de finances a quant à elle opté pour des montants fixés « annuellement », et ce, « par arrêté conjoint du ministre chargé des affaires étrangères et du ministre chargé des finances ». L'arrêté en question a été signé par les deux ministres le 18 juillet dernier et publié au Journal officiel ce dimanche 30 août. Il a pour objet de « fixer la contre-valeur annuelle en monnaie étrangère des droits de timbre exigibles au titre de la délivrance des passeports, par les services diplomatiques et consulaires algériens à l’étranger ». Taux de conversion : voici ce que dit l'arrêté interministériel Cet arrêté interministériel indique que la contre-valeur en devises des droits de timbre pour la délivrance du passeport algérien est fixée « par référence aux taux de conversion annuels communiqués par la Banque d’Algérie, au plus tard, le 7 janvier de l’année considérée ». Ces taux de conversion « sont notifiés, annuellement, au ministre chargé des affaires étrangères, par décision du ministre chargé des finances ». De leur côté, les services diplomatiques et consulaires « sont tenus d’appliquer les taux de conversion annuels, déterminés pour la perception des droits de timbre, exigibles lors de la délivrance des passeports », lit-on dans cet arrêté. Concrètement, c'est la Banque d'Algérie qui communique les nouveaux taux de conversion au ministère des Affaires étrangères, chaque 7 janvier pour la nouvelle année. Les consulats algériens doivent ainsi calculer le montant des droits de timbre selon ces nouveaux taux. Passeport algérien : les nouveaux montant des droits de timbre Il est à noter que les Algériens de l'étranger doivent payer 40 €, depuis le début de l'année 2026, pour la délivrance d'un passeport de 28 pages, dont le montant des droits de timbre en Algérie est de 6.000 dinars algériens. Ce montant était de 60 € avant la parution de cette mesure dans le cadre de la loi de finances 2026, et ce, à cause d’un taux de change obsolète, qui cotait un seul euro à 100 dinars algériens, alors que la Banque d’Algérie affiche clairement un taux d'un euro qui tourne autour des 150 dinars algériens. Ainsi, en se basant sur un taux de conversion de 1 € pour 150 dinars, le timbre pour un passeport de 28 pages revient à 40 €. Pour un passeport de 48 pages, le montant du timbre est de 9.000 dinars algériens, et devrait donc être de 60 € pour les membres de la diaspora. Pour un passeport de 28 pages en procédure accélérée, le prix du timbre à l'étranger devrait être de 166,66 €. Pour ce qui est d'un passeport de 48 pages délivré en procédure accélérée, le tarif sera de 300 € pour les Algériens de l'étranger. L’article Tarifs du passeport algérien pour la diaspora : ce qui change est apparu en premier sur TSA .

items.title: Police arrest two suspects over murder of Yidani chief and son
items.description: The Northern Regional Police Command has arrested two suspects in connection with the murder of the enskinned chief of Yidani, Naa Ntimla Nwenisim, and his son, Ntimla Bilaga. The two were shot dead at their residence in Yidani in the Gushegu District in the early hours of August 14, 2026. Police said three unidentified armed men entered the chief’s compound at about 3:00am and demanded to be directed to his room before forcing their way into the chief’s quarters and opening fire. According to the Northern Regional Police Commander, DCOP Wisdom Lavoe, the bodies of the chief and his son were later found with apparent gunshot wounds. Five empty BB cartridges were recovered from the scene, while a post-mortem conducted at the Tamale Teaching Hospital on August 17 established that both men died from multiple shotgun injuries and haemorrhagic shock. DCOP Lavoe said the Inspector-General of Police subsequently deployed a special operations team to the area, while patrols were intensified in Yidani and neighbouring communities. He said credible intelligence received on August 26 indicated that two suspects were travelling from Dombine towards Chereponi, leading police officers in Chereponi to intercept them. The suspects have been identified as 25-year-old Majejiba Magne and 34-year-old Haruna Nlegle. They were transferred to the Yendi Divisional Command on August 27 and remain in police custody assisting with investigations. The Northern Regional Police Command said investigations are continuing to establish the full circumstances surrounding the killings and identify and arrest any other persons who may have been involved. DCOP Lavoe urged residents in Yidani, Dombine, Gushegu, Chereponi and surrounding communities to provide information that could assist the investigation. He also appealed to the bereaved family and residents to remain calm and avoid reprisals or vigilantism, warning that anyone found culpable would be prosecuted.

items.title: NYSC urges corps members to embrace cultural diversity, sustain national unity
items.description: The National Youth Service Corps (NYSC), Niger, on Sunday urged corps members to embrace Nigeria’s cultural diversity and sustain national unity beyond the orientation camp. The NYSC Coordinator in Niger, Mrs Martina Shuaibu-Ibrahim, made the call at the 2026 Batch B Stream II Cultural Carnival held at the NYSC Permanent Orientation Camp in Paiko. She said the carnival provided an avenue for cultural exchange, integration and the promotion of national unity among corps members from different parts of the country. Shuaibu-Ibrahim said the colourful display of traditional attire, dances and languages reflected Nigeria’s rich cultural heritage and demonstrated the strength of the country’s diversity. The coordinator urged the corps members to build bridges in their host communities and contribute positively to national development throughout their service year. She also encouraged them to acquire and perfect practical skills that would promote self-reliance and prepare them for life after the service year. She urged the corps members to see their deployment to different communities as an opportunity to learn from other cultures and foster peaceful coexistence. Shuaibu-Ibrahim commended the Niger Government for its support for improving facilities at the orientation camp. She said the state government had commenced the renovation and upgrading of key facilities, including the multipurpose hall and hostel roofs, to accommodate more corps members. She added that the government was also strengthening its support for the general running and maintenance of the camp. In his remarks, the Emir of Minna, Dr Umar Farouk, urged the corps members to regard themselves as one people and work together toward building a greater Nigeria, irrespective of ethnic and cultural differences. Farouk, represented by Dantala Maka, commended the NYSC management for sustaining the cultural carnival, describing it as a platform for promoting unity, understanding and peaceful coexistence among young Nigerians. He assured the corps members of the hospitality and support of the people of Niger throughout their service year. Highlights of the carnival included an egg race, a performance by the NYSC Niger State Marshal Band and a martial arts presentation. The organisers also presented awards to winners of various cultural displays. Platoon Seven clinched first position with its Hausa/Fulani cultural presentation, while Platoon Nine came second with its Nupe cultural display. Platoon Five emerged third with its Edo cultural presentation. The post NYSC urges corps members to embrace cultural diversity, sustain national unity appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Mas se pide ser Pogacar en la Vuelta a España
items.description: Sin Pogacar en carrera el ciclismo vuelve a sacar la calculadora y las matemáticas, raciocinio por decreto, datos y números, buscar el ataque idóneo midiendo las fuerzas y sin la ilusión de que se den minutadas de arrea. Atacar a 50 kilómetros, como hizo Pogacar en Andorra hace un telediario, es cosa de Pogacar. El resto, la crème de la crème si no existiera el esloveno , deben atender a sus piernas y atacar al final de las etapas, cuando flaquean las fuerzas. Y eso hizo Gall, catapultado por un trabajo sensacional del Decathlon en el último puerto, el Alto de Aitana, ataque a 6,9 kilómetros y la ley del más fuerte. Levantaron entonces la mano Gall, Roglic, Mas, Carapaz y Onley, abrigados por los pasillos de aficionados que alimentaban el orgullo de los aspirantes. Aunque el mejor, al fin, fue Enric Mas, quien, decía, no le pertenecía el maillot rojo, pero que lo defendió y dignificó como nadie, capaz de vencer su primera etapa en la Vuelta, y eso que cuatro podios le contemplan. “Ahora entiendo a Tadej, el maillot te da alas ”, bromeó al llegar a meta, feliz por el triunfo y el trabajo de su equipo; “poder ganar con este maillot es una sensación muy especial”. items.title: How Albert Bondah, Fredima, Socrate Safo, Counselor Lutterodt engineered Dan Kwaku Yeboah’s comedy show
items.description: Ghanaian sports broadcaster Dan Kwaku Yeboah’s latest comedy show at UPSA auditorium on Friday drew massive patronage and rave reviews. The event, held on Friday, 28th August 2026, was handled by able hands, including Albert Bondah, who teamed up with industry heavyweights Fred Kyei Mensah, Socrate Safo and Counselor Lutterodt. Working behind the scenes, Bondah was in charge of the extensive media tour that created the buzz ahead of the show. His strategic media rollout ensured the event dominated conversations on radio, television and online platforms in the lead-up to the main event. On the night, Bondah also ensured that the red carpet experience was flawlessly executed. The red carpet session was successfully handled by celebrated personalities Big Akwes and Abigail Ashley, adding glamour and excitement to the event. Beyond publicity and red carpet management, Bondah was also responsible for the entire programme line-up for artiste performances. He meticulously coordinated the performances and ensured that all artistes arrived on time to execute their performances without hitches, a move that contributed to the smooth flow of the show. While Bondah handled logistics, programming and media, celebrated music producer and entertainment pundit Fred Kyei Mensah, award-winning filmmaker Socrate Safo and popular relationship counsellor Counselor Lutterodt took charge of directing the show to fit audience expectations. Their combined expertise in show direction, audience psychology and stagecraft ensured that every segment resonated with the audience. Industry watchers have lauded the collaboration as a masterstroke. Albert Bondah, who has been handling major comedy events in Ghana, continues to be credited for the success of these shows because of the diversity of ideas and innovative concepts he brings to each production. His ability to blend organisation, timing and entertainment value has set a new standard for comedy shows in the country. The successful event for Dan Kwaku Yeboah adds to Bondah’s growing portfolio as one of Ghana’s reliable event organisers and further cements his reputation as a driving force behind the growth of comedy in Ghana.

items.title: Le président finlandais appelle l’Europe à renouer le dialogue politique avec la Russie
items.description: Le president finlandais Alexander Stubb a appele les pays europeens a renouer le dialogue politique avec Moscou, alors que les contacts directs entre la Russie et l'Europe restent fortement reduits depuis le debut du conflit en Ukraine. « Je pense que quelqu'un en Europe doit reprendre le dialogue avec la Russie afin de comprendre ce qui s'y passe. Nous devons nous parler au niveau politique », a-t-il declare dans un entretien accorde au quotidien allemand Bild le 29 août. Selon Alexander Stubb, l'absence de communication directe augmente le risque de malentendus et de mauvaises interpretations entre Moscou et les capitales europeennes. Il estime notamment que certaines evolutions peuvent etre percues par la Russie comme de nouvelles menaces en l'absence de contacts politiques permettant de clarifier les positions de chacun. Cette position s'inscrit dans une ligne deja defendue par le president finlandais. a la mi-août, il avait estime qu'un contact avec Moscou devait etre retabli dans les semaines ou les mois a venir et avait egalement plaide pour que l'Europe conserve ses propres canaux de communication avec la Russie. Alexander Stubb a par ailleurs salue le maintien des echanges entre Moscou et Washington, notamment la visite dans la capitale russe du directeur de la CIA, John Ratcliffe. « Je pense que c'est une bonne chose. Vraiment. Je crois que le dialogue est necessaire », a-t-il declare. Il a egalement dit esperer que les militaires russes et americains restent en contact. Stubb met en garde contre une sous-estimation de la Russie Le president finlandais a egalement appele a evaluer avec realisme la capacite de resistance de la Russie. Selon lui, Moscou dispose de patience et d'endurance dans le conflit ukrainien. « Il ne faut jamais sous-estimer la quantite de difficultes economiques que les Russes sont capables de supporter », a-t-il affirme. Alexander Stubb a egalement pris ses distances avec les affirmations selon lesquelles la Russie preparerait une attaque contre l'OTAN. Il a declare ne voir « ni preuves ni faits » permettant d'etayer un tel scenario et a indique ne pas croire que Moscou souhaite attaquer l'Alliance atlantique. Les autorites russes rejettent depuis longtemps les accusations faisant etat de projets d'attaque contre les pays de l'OTAN. Vladimir Poutine a qualifie ces affirmations de « mensonge », tandis que le porte-parole du Kremlin Dmitri Peskov les a presentees comme une « deformation de la realite ». Le debat sur le dialogue divise toujours l'Europe La perspective d'une reprise des echanges avec Moscou continue neanmoins de diviser les responsables europeens. Le ministre polonais des Affaires etrangeres, Radoslaw Sikorski, avait ainsi appele le 28 août les Europeens a ne pas engager de negociations qu'il juge « prematurees » avec la Russie sur le reglement du conflit ukrainien. La position du dirigeant finlandais se distingue de cette approche. Il considere qu'un canal politique direct avec Moscou est necessaire pour permettre aux Europeens de mieux comprendre les positions russes. La Russie affirme de son cote etre prete au dialogue et l'a repete a plusieurs reprises. Vladimir Poutine a notamment declare que l'interruption des contacts venait, selon lui, de l'Union europeenne et non de Moscou. Les declarations d'Alexander Stubb relancent ainsi en Europe le debat sur le retablissement de relations politiques directes avec la Russie apres plusieurs annees de contacts fortement reduits.

items.title: Google Maps renames Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’ in US – but not Canada
items.description: Google redesignated Lake Ontario as “Lake America” on maps seen by US users Sunday after President Donald Trump announced he was renaming the body of water, with a Canadian official slamming the cross-border tensions as “absolutely backwards.” People in Canada will still see Lake Ontario, the Indigenous-rooted name used for the lake since the 17th century, on their devices and computers, the US-based tech giant said. The shock nomenclatural spat erupted as the latest element of Trump’s “America First” narrative, with longtime allies the United States and Canada ramping up a trade war that has seen Washington and Ottawa slap tit-for-tat tariffs on each other. Apple’s Maps app that comes installed on all iPhones makes no mention of “Lake America” on its maps as of Sunday morning. Google said it made its change in line with the US Geographic Names Information System (GNIS), the official federal database for geographic names. “Since we update Google Maps to reflect name changes in official government sources, which is GNIS for the US, people using Maps in the US will see ‘Lake America,’ those in Canada will continue to see ‘Lake Ontario,’ and those outside of the US and Canada will see both names,” Google said on its blog. The change mirrors Trump’s unilateral altering of the name of the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America in January 2025 — a move Mexico has also rejected. Ontario is the smallest by surface area of the five Great Lakes, which straddle the Canada-US border between Ontario province and the US state of New York. The province’s premier, Doug Ford, offered fresh criticism Sunday of the trade dispute and Trump’s lake name change. “It’s absolutely backwards. It was like something out of (US comedy TV show) ‘Saturday Night Live’ when he signed a document saying — changed to ‘Lake America.’ No one’s going to call it Lake of America,” Ford told ABC talk show “This Week.” “It’s just so disappointing.” Ford also warned that while a trade war would harm both countries, “it’d be definitely devastating on the US” given that Canada has been by far the largest purchaser of US vehicles. Should those buys dry up, US auto factories would be hit hard. “A tariff on Canada is nothing more than a tax on American people,” he said. “It’s probably the worst move you could ever do.” Canada and the US have a deeply interconnected auto manufacturing sector, and a sizeable portion of parts for US vehicles are made in Canada. Trump himself waded in Sunday to say Americans “want to make our own cars.” “Canada has been ripping us off for years — NO LONGER!” Trump posted on his Truth Social platform. mlm/pnb The post Google Maps renames Lake Ontario ‘Lake America’ in US – but not Canada appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Fonds politiques I Quand l’Assemblée nationale veut vider le social et le religieux de leur substance : la majorité désaxée devra bien assumer !
items.description: Le président de l’Assemblée nationale s’est rendu dans différents foyers religieux et s'est adonné à un exercice de rattrapage sur sa pratique et sur sa communication sur les crédits spéciaux (fonds politiques). Ce qu’il propose à l’Assemblée nationale n’a rien à voir avec ce qu’il est allé raconter à nos guides religieux ; et n’a surtout rien à voir avec la façon dont il a géré ses propres fonds politiques. C’est un mélange manifeste de double discours et de double standard qui ne l’honore pas ! Sa pratique pose un problème moral profond ! Sa communication distille des messages de justification d'une grande légèreté. Il a essayé de faire croire à nos vénérés guides religieux que la réforme des crédits spéciaux qu'il propose ne les impacterait pas négativement. Cela est rigoureusement inexact. Faux, comme l'atteste une lecture diachronique simple de la proposition de loi de l'Assemblée nationale et des amendements de l'Exécutif. Article 2 de la proposition de l’Assemblée : proposition de crédits anti-sociaux et anti-religieux « Au sens de la présente loi, constituent des crédits spéciaux les crédits budgétaires destinés EXCLUSIVEMENT au financement des dépenses relatives à la défense nationale, la sécurité intérieure et extérieure de l'Etat et aux activités de renseignement. » Article 2 : Amendement de l'Exécutif « Au sens de la présente loi, constituent des crédits spéciaux les crédits budgétaires destinés notamment au financement de dépenses relatives à la défense nationale, à la sécurité intérieure et extérieure de l'État, aux activités de renseignement ainsi qu’à la préservation de l’ordre social, aux valeurs africaines de solidarité, d’entraide et de cohésion sociale, entre autres, dans des situations d’urgence humanitaire, de détresse sociale ou de préservation de la stabilité nationale et des intérêts fondamentaux de la Nation ». Observations sur l'article 2 1. L'Assemblée énumère trois destinations EXCLUSIVES pour les crédits : la défense, la sécurité et les activités de renseignement. C'est technique, restreint, fermé et sans aucune ouverture à quelques considérations sociales, religieuses, humanitaires ou de solidarité. Le terme EXCLUSIVEMENT est utilisé à dessein dans l'article. Aucune mention d'aucune forme de détresse sociale. 2. L'Exécutif rectifie le tir, enlève le caractère exclusif de la destination des fonds et INTRODUIT de nouvelles destinations liées à la préservation de l'ordre social, aux valeurs africaines de solidarité et d'entraide et à la cohésion sociale. Tout est dans l'humain ! Article 4 de la proposition de l’Assemblée « Seules peuvent relever de la catégorie des crédits spéciaux les dépenses dont la divulgation serait, par elle-même, de nature à compromettre la sécurité publique ; la sûreté ou la défense nationale ; les conditions d'opération sensibles intéressant la sécurité nationale ; la protection de sources ou de personnes ; la réussite d'action diplomatique ou de renseignement ». Article 4 : Amendement de l'Exécutif « Peuvent relever de la catégorie des crédits spéciaux les dépenses dont la divulgation serait, par elle-même, de nature à compromettre la sécurité publique, la sûreté, ou la défense nationale ; la conduite d'opérations sensibles intéressant la sécurité nationale ; la protection de sources ou de personnes ; la réussite d'actions diplomatiques ou de renseignement ; la protection de l’ordre public ; la préservation de l’ordre social et des intérêts fondamentaux de la Nation ; les valeurs humanitaires, d’entraide, de solidarité et discrétion ». Observations sur l'article 4 1. L'Assemblée confine le périmètre de la dérogation sur les dépenses éligibles aux questions de défense et de sécurité. 2. L'amendement de l'Exécutif ÉLARGIT le périmètre des dépenses couvertes en introduisant explicitement la protection de l'ordre public, la préservation de l'ordre social, les intérêts fondamentaux de la Nation, et les valeurs humanitaires, d'entraide, de solidarité et de discrétion. Finalement, là où la proposition de l’Assemblée nationale réduit les crédits spéciaux à une pure opération technique et froide de gestion, les amendements de l'Exécutif humanisent et socialisent l'utilisation des fonds en parfaite conformité avec nos traditions culturelles, sociales et religieuses. Là où l’Assemblée élimine et discrimine au mépris de notre socle socioreligieux, l'Exécutif reste adossé à la température du pays, jusque dans ses dimensions endogènes. Là où l'Assemblée exclut, l'Exécutif inclut. Et pour bien s’assurer de son coup d’extirper le social et le religieux des bénéficiaires des fonds politiques, la majorité désaxée prend le soin d’enfoncer le clou à l’article 5 de sa proposition : « Sont exclues les dépenses à caractère social, les dépenses à caractère politique et les dépenses de fonctionnement courant des institutions ». L’approche ici est négative et dit expressément ce qui n’est pas couvert par les fonds politiques. Ne sont donc concernées que les dépenses mentionnées à l’article 2 (défense nationale, sécurité et renseignement). L’approche ici est positive. Elle mentionne ce que couvrent les fonds politiques. Elle est énumérative, limitative et même renforcée de façon redondante par le terme . Il ressort de ces deux approches, positive et négative, que la proposition de loi de l’Assemblée nationale sur les crédits spéciaux est anti-sociale, anti-religieuse, anti-politique, anti-culturelle et est totalement déconnectée de nos réalités sénégalaises ; une négation de nos principes de solidarité et de notre vivre-ensemble ! Mieux, elle ne vise qu’à neutraliser les capacités d’action du Président de la République. Elle ne vise aucun intérêt général. Elle ne défend aucun principe. Elle est de pure subjectivité politique et reste un instrument de règlement de comptes avec le président de la République. Une telle instrumentalisation de nos institutions n’est pas digne des espoirs placés dans les représentants du peuple. Par ailleurs, l'ancien Premier ministre a utilisé à fond et sans réserve ses crédits spéciaux, versus fonds politiques, pendant deux ans, sans autres considérations des restrictions préconisées dans sa proposition actuelle. Il n'a pas jugé utile de se fixer les limites qu'il veut imposer à plus gradé que lui. L'on ne pourra pas dire qu'il s'en est limité à des dépenses liées à la défense et à la sécurité du pays. Et encore ! Les fonds qu'il a par ailleurs utilisés n'ont été soumis à aucune procédure connue et communément acceptée des finances publiques. Et pour couronner le tout, il s’arroge une immunité en programmant la mise en œuvre de ses propositions supposées pro-transparence au 1er janvier 2027, en s’extirpant de tout contrôle. Quant aux destinataires, les réformes proposées vont fatalement exposer leur intimité, sans considération de leur dignité et de leur amour-propre. Malgré les amendements de l'Exécutif, les crédits spéciaux autorisés restent soumis Au président de l’Assemblée nationale, leader de la majorité détournée, assumez votre discrimination de nos foyers religieux dans le fléchage des fonds politiques, pour votre gestion passée comme pour l’avenir ! Votre double discours est mis à nu dès lors que vous ne pouvez pas assumer le contenu de vos positions dans l’hémicycle sur la place publique. C’est à se demander qui vous représentez en fin de compte. La République ! Rien que la République ! Ass Abdourahmane DIOUF Superviseur Général Adjoint KIIRAAY les Patriotes Républicains

items.title: Madagascar : condamné à indemniser 27 familles, le géant minier QMM suspend ses activités
items.description: Le geant minier QMM a annonce le 28 août la suspension de ses activites sur son site d'extraction d'ilmenite pres de Fort-Dauphin, dans le sud-est de Madagascar, apres plusieurs blocages de la route d'acces a la mine par des agriculteurs locaux. Depuis trois semaines, des riverains empechent regulierement l'acces au site, accusant l'entreprise d'etre responsable de l'inondation de leurs terres agricoles. Ils denoncent egalement le refus presume de QMM de se conformer a une decision de justice ordonnant le versement de dommages et interets. Le 18 fevrier, le tribunal de premiere instance de Fort-Dauphin a condamne QMM a verser 9,9 milliards d'ariary, soit plus de 2,2 millions de dollars, a 27 familles d'agriculteurs. Selon le jugement, la construction d'un barrage destine a retenir l'eau necessaire aux activites minieres a entraîne l'inondation de leurs champs et rizieres, rendus inutilisables depuis 2007. La justice avait ordonne le paiement immediat de la moitie des indemnites. Saisie par QMM pour contester cette condamnation, la Cour supreme malgache a rejete son recours le 4 août, selon Transparency International Initiative Madagascar. L'ONG anticorruption a vivement critique la situation, s'interrogeant sur la possibilite pour « une entreprise multinationale » d'ignorer une decision de la Cour supreme alors que des familles affectees rencontrent des difficultes a subvenir a leurs besoins. De son cote, QMM affirme que ses activites ne reprendront que lorsque « la securite des personnes et la libre circulation vers et depuis le site seront durablement garanties ». L'entreprise assure rester engagee dans le dialogue avec les differentes parties concernees. Ce n'est pas la premiere fois que le site est confronte a des tensions avec les populations locales. En 2022, ses activites avaient deja ete suspendues apres des blocages routiers organises par des riverains qui l'accusaient d'avoir provoque des pollutions dans un estuaire voisin.

items.title: Vignette Apostille en Algérie : deux précisions importantes à connaître
items.description: Depuis le 9 juillet dernier, les Algériens peuvent légaliser leurs documents destinés à l’étranger sans avoir à se déplacer jusqu'au ministère des Affaires étrangères, et ce, grâce à l’entrée en vigueur de la procédure Apostille . Dès l’entrée en vigueur de ce nouveau système, la vente des timbres dédiés à cet effet a été lancée, et ce, auprès des receveurs d’impôts et des guichets d’Algérie Poste. Le prix de ce timbre a été fixé à 1.500 dinars algériens. Un arrêté interministériel fixant les modalités de paiement de ces droits de timbre, signé conjointement par le ministre des Affaires étrangères, celui des Finances ainsi que celui de la Poste et des Télécommunications, le 9 juillet dernier, vient d'être publié au Journal officiel. Le texte apporte deux précisions importantes à connaître. La première concerne les lieux de vente de l’Apostille et la seconde est liée à qui a le droit d’apposer la vignette sur les documents à légaliser. Apostille : ce que prévoit le nouveau arrêté Cet arrêté, qui a pour objet de “ fixer les modalités de perception du droit de timbre applicable à l’apostille ”, explique que l’achat d’une vignette Apostille se fait après le paiement d’un droit de timbre et sur présentation d’une pièce d’identité. De plus, cet arrêté interministériel ne manque pas de rappeler qu’une fois la vignette Apostille achetée par le demandeur, ça sera à “ l’autorité compétente ” de l’apposer sur le document à légaliser L’arrêté indique que le droit de timbre est “ acquitté auprès du receveur des impôts ou du responsable de l’établissement postal, contre délivrance d’une vignette autocollante sécurisée ”. “Le montant du droit exigible pour la vente de la vignette apostille est déterminé conformément à la législation en vigueur” , soit 1.500 dinars algériens. Une convention avec Algérie Poste Cela dit, le même arrêté note qu’une “ convention est conclue entre le ministère des finances et Algérie Poste ” dévoilant que cette dernière peut adopter une “commission sur le produit de la vente effective de cette vignette ”. Cet arrêté assure que les services de la direction générale des impôts bénéficient “ d’un accès aux données statistiques du registre national numérisé de délivrance des certificats d’apostille, géré par le ministère chargé des Affaires étrangères ”, et ce, à des fins de suivi. Par ailleurs, cet arrêté dévoile que c’est aux directions des impôts de wilaya d’assurer “ l’approvisionnement des établissements postaux en vignette apostille ”, et ce, “ en fonction des besoins exprimés et sans versement préalable de fonds ”. La Direction générale des impôts est quant à elle responsable de “ l'approvisionnement en vignette apostille auprès de la Banque d’Algérie ”. Yidani chief’s murder: Police arrest two suspects following intelligence tip-off
items.description: Two suspects have been arrested by the Northern Regional Police Command in connection with the murder of the newly enskinned Chief of Yidani, Naa Ntimla Nwenisim, and his son, Ntimla Bilaga. The suspects, 25-year-old Majejiba Magne and 34-year-old Haruna Nlegle, were arrested following intelligence gathered by the police. The Yidani chief and his son were killed on August 14, 2026, when three unidentified armed men reportedly attacked their residence at about 3:00 am and shot them. Police said preliminary investigations indicate the assailants entered the compound and demanded to be directed to the chief’s room. When the demand was refused, the attackers allegedly fired a shot into the roof of a nearby room before forcing their way into the chief’s room, where they shot both victims. Five empty BB cartridges were recovered from the scene. A post-mortem conducted on August 17 at the Tamale Teaching Hospital established that both victims suffered multiple injuries consistent with shotgun assaults and died from severe injuries and haemorrhagic shock. The Inspector-General of Police deployed a special operations team from Police Headquarters after the attack. Security patrols were also intensified in Yidani and neighbouring communities. According to the police, they received credible intelligence on August 26 that two persons suspected to be involved in the murders were travelling from Dombine in the Gushegu District towards Chereponi. The Gushegu Police alerted their counterparts in Chereponi, who intercepted and arrested the two suspects. They were later transferred to the Yendi Divisional Command and have since been remanded in police custody to assist with investigations. The Northern Regional Police Command said investigations were ongoing to establish the full circumstances of the murders and to identify and arrest any other persons who may have participated in the attack. Police have appealed to residents of Yidani, Dombine, Gushegu, Chereponi and surrounding communities to provide credible information to assist the investigation, assuring the public that such information would be treated confidentially. The command also urged the bereaved family, youth and residents to remain calm and avoid reprisals or vigilantism, stressing that anyone found culpable would be dealt with according to law.

Government to connect 206 Volta communities to national grid within six months – Energy Minister
items.description: The government is set to extend electricity to 206 unelectrified communities across 18 districts in the Volta Region under the Rural Electricity Acceleration and Urban Intensification Initiative (REIP). The Minister for Energy and Green Transition, John Abdulai Jinapor, said the project, being implemented by Byes and Ways Limited, is expected to be completed within six months. Speaking at the sensitisation and launch of the project in Ho on Sunday, August 30, 2026, Mr Jinapor said the initiative forms part of the government’s flagship Big Push programme aimed at accelerating electricity access across the country. He said government had allocated GH¢598 million to the Volta Region project, describing the investment as part of efforts to close the electricity access gap and extend development opportunities to underserved communities. “Government is committed to completing these works within six months,” Mr Jinapor said, stressing that the Ministry would closely monitor the project to ensure quality, value for money and timely completion. He said government had adopted a targeted regional approach to aggressively connect unelectrified communities to the national grid over the next four years, with the Savannah, Central, Oti and Volta Regions selected for this year’s interventions. The Minister said the broader objective was to achieve universal electricity access by 2030, ensuring that communities across Ghana were not left behind in the country’s development. Mr Jinapor urged traditional authorities, local assemblies and beneficiary communities to support the project by facilitating access to project sites, resolving right-of-way challenges and protecting project materials. He also called on residents to guard the infrastructure against vandalism and illegal connections, observe electrical safety practices and pay their electricity bills promptly to support the sustainability of the power sector.

items.title: Oyo APC: Aggrieved assembly aspirants drop grievances, back Tinubu, 2027 candidates
items.description: By Adeola Badru The All Progressives Congress (APC) in Oyo State has reconciled most aspirants who contested its recent House of Assembly primary election, with the aspirants pledging to work for the party’s success across the state’s 32 constituencies in the 2027 general elections. The development is being seen as a significant step towards rebuilding cohesion within the party ahead of the 2027 elections, particularly after protests and grievances reportedly followed the conduct and outcome of the House of Assembly primary that produced the party’s candidates for the election. In a communique issued on Sunday at the end of the reconciliation meetings by the Chairman, Oyo State APC House of Assembly Reconciliation Committee, Alhaji Mufitau Adisa Gbayawu, Co-Chairman, Bisoye Fagade, and Secretary, Barr. Dr Rotimi Okeowo, the party noted that: “Substantial progress has been made in resolving the issues and grievances arising from the exercise.” The committee disclosed that it had engaged extensively with aspirants who purchased nomination forms, as well as other stakeholders and party members who expressed interest in the electoral process, stressing that the engagements were undertaken in the spirit of “reconciliation, unity, mutual understanding and the collective interest” of the APC in Oyo State. According to the committee, the outcome of the engagements showed that most aspirants demonstrated maturity and sportsmanship by choosing the party’s larger interest over their individual political ambitions. “The Committee is pleased to report that the majority of the aspirants who participated in the primary election, including those who purchased nomination forms and those who did not, have demonstrated commendable sportsmanship, maturity and commitment to the unity of the Party,” the communique stated. It added that the reconciled aspirants had “expressed their readiness to work harmoniously with one another and with the leadership of the Party towards securing electoral victory for the APC in the 2027 general elections”. The committee further revealed that the reconciled aspirants had pledged their support for the re-election of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and the election of APC candidates contesting the Senate, House of Representatives and Oyo State House of Assembly elections. “In furtherance of this commitment, the reconciled aspirants pledged their support for the re-election of His Excellency, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, GCFR, as well as the election of the APC candidates for the Senate, House of Representatives and the Oyo State House of Assembly,” it said. The committee particularly commended the aspirants for placing the collective interest of the APC above individual ambitions, describing their decision as a demonstration of commitment to strengthening the party across the state. It also called on APC leaders, members, stakeholders, and supporters to sustain the reconciliation process and avoid actions that could reopen divisions within the party. “The Committee further calls on all members, leaders, stakeholders and supporters of the APC in Oyo State to embrace the spirit of reconciliation, eschew divisive tendencies and work collectively towards building a stronger, more united and electorally formidable Party,” it said. Earlier, Gbayawu explained that the reconciliation committee had met with the aggrieved aspirants one-on-one to allow them to present their grievances and concerns over the primary election. He acknowledged the right of party members and aspirants to express dissatisfaction with aspects of the electoral process, but maintained that such grievances should ultimately give way to the party’s larger interest. “During our interaction with the aspirants in their respective areas, they made known their grievances which formed the basis for the protest,” Gbayawu said. He added: “The leadership of the APC respects the rights of not only the aspirants but the members as well, hence the reason for setting up the Reconciliation Committees to pacify those members whose feelings have been injured.” The committee chairman thanked the aspirants for their willingness to move beyond their individual interests and support the party’s collective objective ahead of 2027. “We thank the aggrieved aspirants and members for their resolve to drop their personal ambitions and work for the collective interest of the party in the 2027 election,” he said. Presenting the outcome of the reconciliation exercise, Fagade described the process as fruitful, stressing that the willingness of the aspirants to collaborate with the party leadership had created a stronger foundation for electoral mobilisation. The Oyo State APC Gubernatorial Reconciliation Committee also joined the reconciliation effort, with its Co-Chairman, Senator Olufemi Lanlehin, appealing for continued unity among members. Lanlehin, who spoke from his experience of contesting and losing elections, said he understood the aspirants’ frustrations but praised them for choosing the party’s interest over personal grievances. “I have won and lost elections for elective political offices in the past. I know what it takes. I feel your pains, but you have taken the rightful decision to work for the interest of the party,” he said. His fellow Co-Chairman, Prof. Taoheed Adedoja, also commended the aspirants for deciding to collaborate with the party leadership towards ensuring electoral success for the APC. The APC governorship candidate in Oyo State, Sharafadeen Alli, equally welcomed the reconciliation, describing the decision of the aspirants to work together as necessary for the party’s success in 2027. Alli assured party members that, if elected governor of the state on May 29, 2027, he would work with all stakeholders and promised to implement local government fiscal autonomy in Oyo State. The reconciliation comes against the backdrop of other efforts by prominent APC figures to prevent internal disagreements from affecting the party’s preparations for 2027. The committee expressed confidence that the renewed cooperation among the aspirants and other stakeholders would significantly improve the party’s chances at the polls. “Together, with unity of purpose and commitment, we can secure a resounding victory for the APC in Oyo State in 2027,” the committee declared. items.title: Petrol, diesel and LPG prices expected to rise marginally in September – COPEC
items.description: Petroleum prices are expected to record marginal increases at fuel stations from Tuesday, September 1, 2026, the Chamber of Petroleum Consumers (COPEC) has projected. According to COPEC, petrol is expected to record the biggest increase, with the projected retail price rising to GH¢16.21 per litre, representing a 5% increase from the current average price of GH¢15.43 per litre. The projections were contained in a statement issued on August 30, 2026, and signed by COPEC Executive Secretary, Duncan Amoah. The projection comes despite a marginal decline in global crude oil prices and an appreciation of the Ghana cedi against the US dollar during the current pricing window. COPEC said the average global crude price declined from $90.41 to $89.30 per barrel, while the cedi appreciated by about 2.39%, moving from an average interbank rate of GH¢11.80 to the dollar at the start of the window to GH¢11.5166 at its close. However, the chamber said the gains from the currency appreciation were outweighed in the case of petrol by a significant increase in its international Free on Board (FOB) price. The FOB price of petrol rose from $1,033.15 to $1,136.50 per metric tonne, representing a 10% increase. COPEC consequently projects that petrol could sell between GH¢15.40 and GH¢17.02 per litre, within a ±5% margin of its projection. For diesel, COPEC projects a retail price of GH¢17.61 per litre, up from the current average of GH¢17.17. The chamber said the international FOB price of diesel declined marginally from $1,251.19 to $1,250.50 per metric tonne, while the appreciation of the cedi was factored into the projected pump price. Diesel is therefore expected to sell between GH¢16.73 and GH¢18.49 per litre, within the chamber’s ±5% projection range. LPG prices are also expected to increase marginally. COPEC projects LPG to sell at GH¢14.19 per kilogramme, compared with the current price, after its international FOB price increased from $596 to $611 per metric tonne, representing a 2.64% rise. Within a ±5% margin of error, LPG could sell between GH¢13.48 and GH¢14.90 per kilogramme, according to the chamber. In view of the anticipated increases, COPEC has appealed to the government to extend its fuel subsidy intervention beyond the end of August. It said maintaining the intervention would help cushion consumers until international petroleum benchmarks return to more favourable levels. COPEC also urged Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs) to maintain the current ex-pump price of diesel to help ease the impact of the expected increases on consumers. 1st Window September Download

items.title: Canada installs large Lake Ontario sign in latest jab at US
items.description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford has hit back at Donald Trump by installing a large sign on Canada’s shoreline with the message: “Lake Ontario. Now and Always.” The US president signed an executive order on Thursday seeking to change its name to Lake America and has shared a series of AI-generated videos about the lake that straddles both countries. “Long before President Trump, this lake was called Lake Ontario. Long after President Trump is gone, it will still be called Lake Ontario,” Ford said. The war of words was triggered after trade talks collapsed, with the US imposing new 50% tariffs on $20bn (C$28bn) of Canadian goods. Canada will implement “dollar for dollar” counter-tariffs next month. Trump said the decree was effective immediately as he signed the order to rename it Lake America. While he has broad discretion over how the US recognises landmarks, other countries are not required to follow. On Saturday, Google said it had changed the name on its maps for users in the US. “Since we update Google Maps to reflect name changes in official government sources, which is GNIS [Geographic Names Information System] for the US, people using Maps in the US will see ‘Lake America’, those in Canada will continue to see ‘Lake Ontario’ and those outside of the US and Canada will see both names,” the tech firm said in a blog post. This mirrors how Google names the Gulf of Mexico for users after Trump declared it was called the Gulf of America in 2025. Canadian officials have dismissed Trump’s move. On Saturday, Trump also posted several AI-generated videos on social media, with one showing him kicking over a Lake Ontario sign and replacing it with one that says: “Welcome to Lake America.” Another video depicted a flock of Canada geese sporting the US president’s trademark hair and holding rifles as they patrolled the shoreline of a newly named Lake America. Ford said Trump’s renaming of the lake was because he “didn’t like Ontario and Canada standing up for ourselves”. Standing in front of the newly unveiled Lake Ontario sign, Ford added: “Just in case President Trump or anyone else forgets, we’ve set up this sign to remind them, it’s Lake Ontario, now and forever.” It echoes Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney’s previous response to the row, insisting “things must be called by their name, and this lake is called Lake Ontario – today and forever”. The names of four of the Great Lakes – Ontario, Huron, Michigan and Erie – originate from indigenous words. Lake Superior was named after an anglicised French word. Lake Ontario, the smallest of the Great Lakes, borders both the Canadian province and the US state of New York. Trump’s executive order gives the US Department of the Interior 30 days to update the name change with the Geographic Names Information Service – the official repository of domestic geographic names in the US. Mexico similarly rejected Trump’s renaming of the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America, arguing a single country could not rename a shared body of international water.

Sambo: la Fédération guinéenne dévoile les couleurs du Championnat national et de la Coupe nationale
items.description: La Fédération guinéenne de Sambo a tenu samedi 29 août 2026, un point de presse pour faire le point sur les préparatifs du Championnat et de la Coupe nationale de Sambo, prévus à Mamou, à la fin du mois de septembre. Selon le président de cette discipline sportive, ce rendez-vous constitue une étape majeure dans la vie de la Fédération et s'inscrit dans son ambition de faire du Sambo une discipline toujours plus forte, mieux structurée et davantage accessible à la jeunesse guinéenne. A cette occasion, les organisateurs ont annoncé la participation de nombreux athlètes issus de différentes régions ainsi que de plusieurs clubs du pays. L'objectif affiché est de faire de cette compétition un véritable rendez-vous de la jeunesse autour des valeurs fondamentales du sport: discipline, respect, courage, dépassement de soi et excellence. À en croire le président de la Fédération guinéenne de Sambo, Maître Amadou Sadigou Bah, « C'est la première fois que la Fédération Guinéenne de Sambo organise un Championnat national couplé à une Coupe nationale sous cette forme. Mais nous abordons ce défi avec sérénité, parce que nous avons déjà démontré notre capacité à organiser des événements sportifs de haut niveau. La Guinée a notamment eu l'honneur d'abriter les Championnats d'Afrique de Sambo, une organisation qui a été saluée et appréciée au plus haut niveau de la discipline. Cette expérience constitue pour nous un véritable acquis. Aujourd'hui, nous voulons nous appuyer sur cette expérience pour réussir le pari de Mamou », a-t-il expliqué. Poursuivant son intervention, le premier responsable de la Fédération a indiqué être pleinement conscient des défis qu'implique l'organisation d'une compétition nationale de cette envergure : « C'est pourquoi nous ne voulons minimiser aucun détail, qu'il s'agisse de l'accueil des délégations, de la logistique, de l'organisation technique, de l'hébergement, de la sécurité ou encore du déroulement des compétitions », a-t-il assuré. L'ambition affichée est claire : « offrir aux athlètes, aux officiels, aux experts et à nos invités des conditions dignes d'un événement à la hauteur de la réputation que la Guinée s'est progressivement construite dans le Sambo. Plusieurs commissions d'organisation ont été mises en place. Elles travaillent aujourd'hui d'arrache-pied, chacune dans son domaine de compétence, afin que rien ne soit laissé au hasard ». Plus loin, Maître Amadou Sadigou Bah a annoncé l'organisation d'un stage de préparation avant les compétitions afin de garantir leur réussite : « Pour nous, ce stage est fondamental. Il permettra de mettre à niveau les connaissances, de partager les nouvelles pratiques et de renforcer les compétences de nos différents acteurs. Une attention particulière sera accordée à la formation des officiels guinéens, car nous voulons disposer d'un corps d'arbitres et de juges suffisamment qualifiés pour accompagner durablement le développement du Sambo en Guinée ». À travers cette initiative, la Fédération guinéenne de Sambo entend également poser les bases du développement durable de la discipline en misant sur le partage d'expériences : « En tant que président ayant la responsabilité de la zone Ouest, nous voulons profiter de cette occasion pour renforcer les capacités des officiels et acteurs de la sous-région, favoriser le partage d'expériences et contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques. Il ne s'agit donc pas seulement de préparer une compétition. Il s'agit de préparer l'avenir du Sambo ». Le président de la Fédération a également justifié le choix de la ville de Mamou pour accueillir cette double compétition. « Nous voulons sortir d'une logique exclusivement concentrée à Conakry et rapprocher davantage le Sambo des jeunes à l'intérieur du pays. Organiser ces compétitions à Mamou permettra de susciter davantage d'intérêt pour la discipline, de mobiliser les jeunes, d'identifier de nouveaux talents et de donner aux athlètes venus de différentes régions l'occasion de s'exprimer sur une même plateforme », a-t-il dit. Concluant ses propos, le président de la Fédération guinéenne de Sambo s'est montré confiant quant à la réussite de l'événement. Il estime qu'avec l'accompagnement des partenaires, l'engagement des différentes commissions, la mobilisation des athlètes, le soutien des autorités locales, l'appui du Gouvernement ainsi que le concours des médias, cette édition du Championnat national et de la Coupe nationale de Sambo connaîtra un véritable succès. items.title: 'They can come to Pakistan today': Khawaja Asif disputes claim of Imran's sons of expired Nicops
items.description: Defence Minister Khawaja Asif on Sunday said that PTI founder Imran Khan’s sons — Qasim and Sulaiman Khan — could visit Pakistan “today if they wished”, citing the validity of their National Identity Cards for Overseas Pakistanis (Nicop). The government has consistently maintained that Imran’s children can enter the country based on their Nicops with no visa required. However, the sons claimed earlier this month that their Nicops have expired and accused the government of denying them visas. In a post on social media platform X, the defence minister recalled that the ex-premier’s sons had last travelled to Pakistan on their Nicops in November 2022 , when the PTI founder got injured in an assassination attempt . “They can visit Pakistan today if they wish. Both Nicops are valid,” Asif stated. He also shared partially censored Nicop numbers for both Kasim and Sulaiman, stating that the document was valid until Nov 8, 2032 for Kasim and Jan 6, 2030, for Suleman. The minister dismissed the perception that the government was denying them visas as “incorrect”, accusing Imran’s family and PTI of concocting the narrative. “Holders of Nicops can travel to Pakistan whenever they wish. There is no need for a visa,” he maintained. A day earlier, the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MOIB) had addressed the potential arrival of Imran’s sons, noting that they may enter the country through their Nicops, but that access to the country may not guarantee access to prison visitation. As Kasim and his older brother Suleiman live in London with their mother and Imran’s former spouse Jemima Goldsmith, they will have to travel to Pakistan to meet Imran, who is imprisoned at Rawalpindi’s Adiala jail. In December 2025, Kasim had said that he and his brother had applied for their visas. However, in February, Kasim claimed that the government was “deliberately” refusing to process his and his brother’s visas. The next month, Goldsmith made a “direct appeal” to Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to grant her sons visas. In response to the appeal, Information Minister Attaullah Tarar said that Imran’s children were welcome to visit Pakistan on their Nicops. Meanwhile, Goldsmith alleged that the government was recommending that her sons travel to Pakistan on Nicops as they would have “no British protection”, expressing fear that they may be arrested on arrival. In her statement, Goldsmith had claimed that the government was refusing her sons’ visas and held that they also did not have their renewed Nicops. Imran was sent to jail on August 5, 2023, in the Toshakhana case. However, he is also serving a 14-year sentence in a £190 million corruption case , was convicted in another Toshakhana case in December 2025 and also faces pending trials in terrorism cases related to the May 9, 2023 riots . The ex-premier’s sons, along with his party and family, have been protesting against the lack of meetings and phone calls with him despite court orders for the same.

items.title: Nigeria records $947m remittances in July, nears $1bn monthly target
items.description: By Babajide Komolafe LAGOS — Nigeria recorded $947 million in remittance inflows through International Money Transfer Operators (IMTOs) in July 2026, the highest monthly inflow ever recorded through formal channels, according to the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN). The figure brings the apex bank closer to its $1 billion monthly remittance target set by Governor Olayemi Cardoso. According to the CBN, remittance inflows through IMTOs reached $3.8 billion in the first seven months of 2026, representing a 50.2 per cent increase compared with the corresponding period in 2025. The increase followed a series of reforms introduced by the apex bank to make formal remittance channels more competitive, transparent and accessible. The reforms include the move towards a more market-determined exchange rate, changes to the regulatory framework for IMTOs and the introduction of the Non-Resident Bank Verification Number (NRBVN). The CBN has also intensified engagement with IMTOs, banks and Nigerian diaspora communities while strengthening requirements for remittance transactions to be routed through designated settlement accounts with authorised dealer banks. Commenting on the July figure, Cardoso said the development showed that the country was getting closer to achieving its formal remittance target. “When we set a clear ambition to reach $1 billion a month in remittance inflows through formal channels nearly two years ago, some people thought we were dreaming. At $947 million in July, we are now approaching that milestone,” he said. The CBN said the significance of the rising inflows extended beyond the headline figures, noting that increased diaspora remittances through formal channels could boost foreign exchange liquidity and transparency, support households and investment, and strengthen Nigeria’s external financing position. The apex bank, however, said individual monthly figures could fluctuate, stressing that its focus remained on sustaining the broader upward trend and shifting more remittance transactions into formal channels. The bank said the growth recorded so far in 2026 indicated the potential impact of reforms aimed at improving the competitiveness, accessibility and transparency of formal remittance channels. It said the reforms would be complemented by deeper engagement with Nigerian diaspora communities and financial-sector partners across major remittance corridors. The CBN said it would also use international engagements in major global financial centres to engage diaspora communities, IMTOs, banks and other stakeholders on measures to reduce transaction friction, widen access and bring more remittance flows into formal channels. Cardoso said the July performance should be viewed as part of a longer-term strategy rather than an isolated achievement. “July is an important marker, but our focus is not on a single month. It is on creating the conditions for sustained growth in formal remittances. “We expect to keep seeing improvement and believe Nigeria can reach and ultimately sustain monthly inflows above $1 billion,” he said. items.title: 2027: ‘Tinubu should step down for Obi,’ Igbo Group tells campaigners
items.description: By Emmanuel Iheaka OWERRI — The Igbo Heroes and Icons Foundation (IHIF) has rejected moves by the Renewed Hope for Greater Nigeria (RHGN), a campaign group supporting President Bola Tinubu, to persuade former Labour Party presidential candidate, Peter Obi, to withdraw from the 2027 presidential race. RHGN, through its Deputy National Leader (South-East), Mazi Franklin Ngoforo, had announced plans to meet Igbo leaders, including Ohanaeze Ndigbo and former Commonwealth Secretary-General, Chief Emeka Anyaoku, to persuade Obi to support Tinubu’s bid to complete eight years in office. However, in a statement on Sunday, the National Coordinator of IHIF, Chinedu Nsofor, urged the group to allow Obi to exercise his constitutional right to contest the election. IHIF, which is campaigning for a president of Igbo extraction in 2027, has adopted Obi as its preferred candidate for the election. Nsofor challenged RHGN to instead mobilise support for the Igbo presidency project and prevail on Tinubu to step down for Obi in the 2027 election, saying such a move would promote equity, justice and fairness. He said Nigerians should be allowed to freely choose their preferred candidate at the polls. “In any civilised clime, conscience based on equity, fairness and justice supremely prevails in all dealings. This fairness, equity and justice guarantee unity, peace, progress and national cohesion, particularly in a country like Nigeria where cultural and tribal diversities are highly pronounced,” Nsofor said. He argued that the Igbo had made significant sacrifices for Nigeria’s unity and deserved an opportunity to produce the president. According to him, the rotation of the presidency since 1999 had largely favoured the North and South-West. Nsofor noted that former President Olusegun Obasanjo, a Yoruba, served for eight years, while former Presidents Umaru Yar’Adua and Muhammadu Buhari, both from the North, served a combined 11 years. He added that former President Goodluck Jonathan, from the South-South, served for five years. “After Buhari’s tenure in May 2023, every right-thinking Nigerian expected that it was to be the turn of the Igbo to produce the successor to Buhari. But that was not to be,” he said. Nsofor further argued that the Yoruba and Hausa-Fulani had dominated the presidency over the years, while the Igbo had not had a sustained opportunity to lead the country since independence. He said the Igbo had only occupied the presidency for about six months on an interim basis, while the Yoruba and Hausa-Fulani had each produced presidents for considerably longer periods. The IHIF coordinator also questioned the application of the federal character principle, asking whether an Igbo jurist had ever been appointed Chief Justice of Nigeria despite the contributions of eminent Igbo jurists. Nsofor, however, urged Nigerians to prioritise competence over ethnicity and religion when choosing their leaders in 2027. “Let us avoid electing a leader that does not know the balance of ninety-seven percent removed from hundred percent… University graduates should be preferred to school certificate holders for presidential candidate; not graduates without certificates,” he said. He said the 2027 election presented an opportunity to change the pattern of political leadership in the country. “Doing one thing in the same way every time will not give a different result. Let us shift this national leadership base to this untried tribe — the Igbo tribe — and see what happens. “The forthcoming 2027 presidential election is the golden opportunity to explore this governmental leadership revolutionary change,” he stated. items.title: EPL: Chelsea survive Brighton scare in 4-3 thriller
items.description: Chelsea’s fearsome front three stretched Xabi Alonso’s perfect start at Stamford Bridge in a thrilling 4-3 win over Brighton on Sunday. Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer scored as Alonso’s reign kicked off with a 3-2 win at Fulham on Monday. Pedro and Palmer were on target once more, while Rogers teed up Chelsea’s second goal scored by Pedro Neto as the Blues held off a rally from Brighton that threatened to snatch a point. Emi Martinez was thrown straight into goal for his Chelsea debut just hours after sealing his move from Aston Villa and became the first player over 30 to start a league game for the Blues in more than two years in the process. But there was no place for his Argentina teammate Enzo Fernandez, who could still leave for Manchester City before Tuesday’s transfer deadline. Brighton were 4-0 up inside 31 minutes against Villa last weekend, but this time found themselves three goals down in just over half an hour. Romeo Lavia profited from a mix-up between Bart Verbruggen and Mats Wieffer to prod in the opening goal from a corner. Neto then turned in Rogers’s cross before Pedro rounded off a brilliant Chelsea counter-attack that began inside their own box. Martinez was beaten moments later by a blistering volley from Malick Yalcouye that brought Brighton back into the game. Yalcouye was involved again as Pedro turned Pascal Gross’s cross into his own net just after the hour mark. Diego Gomez fired just wide and Martinez denied Olivier Boscagli an equaliser as Chelsea were suddenly clinging on. But a moment of genius from Palmer sparked wild celebrations from Alonso as he curled into the bottom corner from outside the box after a solo run across the Brighton defence. Overlooked by England manager Thomas Tuchel for the World Cup, Palmer has begun the season in top form to give Chelsea hope they could challenge for a first league title since 2016/17. Gross headed in a stoppage time consolation for Brighton, but Chelsea join City and Hull as the only two sides to take six points from their opening two games. Brentford were on course to also maintain their perfect start when Kevin Schade’s audacious flick opened the scoring away to Leeds. But Dominic Calvert-Lewin turned in Lukas Nmecha’s driven cross to salvage a point and Leeds’ unbeaten start to the campaign. Sunderland got off the mark with a 1-0 victory over Fulham thanks to Wilson Isidor’s winner 15 minutes from time. Manchester United are aiming to bounce back from their opening weekend shocker at Hull against another newly-promoted side Ipswich at Old Trafford later. Marcus Rashford makes his first start for the Red Devils in nearly two years after loan spells at Aston Villa and Barcelona in one of four changes made by Michael Carrick. items.title: RDC : le gouvernement envisage une banque publique pour résorber le déficit de logements
items.description: Le gouvernement de la Republique democratique du Congo ( RDC ) souhaite renforcer son intervention dans le secteur du logement face a un deficit qui depasse quatre millions d'unites a l'echelle nationale. Lors du Conseil des ministres du 28 août, la Premiere ministre Judith Suminwa a propose d'etudier la transformation du Fonds national de l'habitat (FONHAB) en une veritable banque publique dediee au secteur. Les ministres de l'Urbanisme et des Finances ont ete charges d'examiner cette reforme. La future institution aurait notamment pour objectif de mobiliser des financements a long terme, de developper le credit hypothecaire et de faciliter l'acces des menages a la propriete. Elle pourrait egalement contribuer a valoriser le patrimoine immobilier de l'etat et a securiser les programmes de logements sociaux. L'ampleur des besoins illustre l'enjeu auquel fait face le pays. Selon des estimations de la Societe financiere internationale (SFI), la RDC aurait besoin de 132 milliards de dollars d'investissements pour resorber son deficit en logements, soit environ sept fois le budget annuel de l'etat. Le pays devrait construire quelque 250 000 logements supplementaires chaque annee pendant 15 ans pour repondre a la demande. Kinshasa concentre a elle seule pres de la moitie du deficit national, avec un besoin estime a 140 000 logements par an. Pour les autorites congolaises, la reforme envisagee ne se limite pas a accroître l'offre de logements. Elle doit egalement permettre d'attirer davantage de capitaux prives, de soutenir la creation d'emplois et de renforcer la stabilite sociale.

items.title: Kintinian : une tentative de braquage d’une agence Orange Money tourne au drame
items.description: Les attaques à main armée, devenues plus rares ces derniers mois dans la région administrative de Siguiri grâce aux efforts conjugués des forces de défense et de sécurité et des populations, semblent refaire surface. Dans la nuit du samedi 29 au dimanche 30 août 2026, une tentative de braquage visant une agence Orange Money a viré au drame à Kintinian, localité située à environ 35 kilomètres de Siguiri. Selon les informations recueillies sur place, plusieurs individus présentés comme des présumés bandits ont fait irruption dans l’agence avec l’intention de s’emparer des recettes. Mais l’opération aurait tourné au règlement de comptes entre les assaillants. Aucun butin n’aurait finalement été emporté. En revanche, l’attaque a fait des victimes. Le gérant de l’agence a été grièvement blessé par balle. Il aurait notamment perdu deux doigts dans les tirs. Dans leur fuite, les assaillants auraient abandonné sur les lieux le corps sans vie de l’un de leurs présumés complices, ainsi qu’un chargeur de PMAK et un téléphone portable, des éléments susceptibles d’aider les enquêteurs à faire la lumière sur les circonstances de cette affaire. Le corps a été transporté au poste de santé de Boukaria, où il se trouve actuellement. Une enquête a été ouverte par les autorités locales afin d’identifier les auteurs de cette attaque et de déterminer les circonstances exactes du drame. Aux dernières nouvelles, l’identité de l’homme retrouvé mort n’avait pas encore été officiellement établie. L’enquête se poursuit. Mamoudou Kéïta, correspondant à Kintinian 628 61 88 90 L’article Kintinian : une tentative de braquage d’une agence Orange Money tourne au drame est apparu en premier sur Mediaguinee.com .
